title: iberis grosmiquelii subsp. senneniana
intro: Iberis grosmiquelii subsp. senneniana, commonly known as Spurred Cress, is a plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including the ability to treat skin conditions, such as eczema and acne, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial agent, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Iberis grosmiquelii subsp. senneniana include isothiocyanates and glucosinolates, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
